_doc: Operator-pinned distribution constants. These are NOT user-tunable settings (those live in ~/.config/local_scribe/config.json); these are security-critical identity values for the third-party binaries local_scribe drives (Char, LM Studio). They were previously hardcoded in run.sh + char_integrity.py and were collected here so an operator can sign them as a single trust statement via `./run.sh config sign` (Touch ID + YubiKey). See local_scribe/security/signed_config.py for the signing mechanism and docs/SECURITY.md for the threat model. To bump a value: edit this file, audit the diff carefully, then `./run.sh config sign` to re-bless. The server refuses to start with an invalid signature.
